locations.note: In 2000 the Scotland Yard detective Brent Halligan is handed the ritual 'Skeleton Murders'.
The case begins in Chief Miller's office and Halligan's own, the room beside the Coke machine.
The first crime scene: a bone and a patch of burnt grass in Epping Forest.
The investigation leads to Dr Melanie Turner and the Oxford Anthropological Museum.
The ferry from Portsmouth takes Halligan to the Old Castle de Carmors to find the lost amulet.

A dark ceremony at Stonehenge in 1000 AD opens the game, and the final ritual must be stopped there; between them the Twelve Bridges gate sends Halligan a thousand years back to a monastery and two temples that exist only in the game.
